0022600121.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-2, 10th in the East) visit the Boston Celtics (1-1, 8th in the East) for their fourth game of the season, with the Bulls 1-1 on the road and the Celtics 1-0 at home. Nic Claxton is out for Chicago with a hamstring injury, while Noa Essengue (head bruise) and Patrick Williams (groin soreness) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions, and Boston is missing Devin Carter, who is out with an illness. The teams have not met yet this season, and the 2025-26 series ended with the Bulls losing 1-2, including a 124-105 defeat in Boston in their last meeting on February 11.
